On more than one occasion, they have even followed up with a phone call to check on my wellbeing, which I truly appreciated. While this level of care should be standard, unfortunately, it isn’t something many practices offer.

One feature I find especially valuable is that a doctor works alongside the phone staff. This allows them to quickly consult and ensure that each patient receives the most appropriate treatment without unnecessary delays. Their call-back service is another example of thoughtful care. While it seems like something all GP practices should offer, it’s surprisingly rare—but thankfully, Ball Tree Surgery does it well.

I really appreciated that they didn’t try to justify the earlier misjudgment or respond defensively.

Appointments are also managed within a reasonable timeframe, with the longest wait I’ve experienced being around two weeks, which is quite fair by today’s standards.
